name: Armed with Proof — dynamically gained Equipment boost applies
notes: Memory: project_equipped_creature_carrier_condition_2026-05-28. 'Equipped creature gets +2/+0' granted to Clues was gated on an Equipment-carrier check that fails when the Equipment subtype is gained dynamically, so the boost silently never applied. Here Armed with Proof makes a Clue an Equipment; attached to Grizzly Bears it must give +2/+0 (4/2). Grizzly Bears B is the unequipped control and stays 2/2. The Clue is attached with applyEquipAttachment (index 1 is its granted Equip ability), the same path the Equip popup uses for Equipment that is not printed as Equipment. Bears B has nothing attached and must not get the boost.
